method: Test that a fresh operator can resolve authority, task sequence, skills, validations, output receipts and stop conditions from repository entrypoints without chat history; replay existing GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4.8 receipts through the model-neutral schemas.
results: The required reading order reaches current authority and task routing before historical context.
Claude Code and Codex discovery adapters resolve the same repository-owned skill sources.
Task, context, receipt and evaluation schemas validate named-model work without model-specific fields.
CERT-01 and PORT-04 state, scope and stop conditions are recoverable without conversation history.
The benchmark prompt requires no repository tools or hidden context.
limitation: A fresh controlled Claude Opus run could not be executed because the installed Claude CLI is not authenticated. Existing repository evidence from Claude Opus 4.8 was schema-replayed; the controlled same-prompt transfer result is recorded only for GPT-5.6 Codex.
